about: Cross-witness labels for the public Simpson civil-case depositions (archive-derived TXT exports of thesimpsonmatter.com / walraven.org; not certified transcripts). Labels supplied by the developer in labels/known_conflicts.tsv and labels/negative_controls.tsv. Lines are the archive's statement numbers; in the Jan 23, 1996 file the archive's count starts again twice, so its anchors name the part (the run of the count) as well.

pairs.topic: nervous breakdown and Puerto Rico calls
pairs.note: Simpson says Nicole reported a nervous breakdown and that he discussed it with Faye, who blamed Cora. Resnick denies knowledge of a nervous breakdown and denies that Simpson discussed that subject with her. Both accounts support that calls occurred; do not label as proven contradiction. (source label: conflicting_accounts / candidate_conflict_with_context)

Resnick gives affirmative firsthand observations in October and December 1993. Simpson's relevant answer was interrupted by counsel and he refused the follow-up question; this is not a clean denial and must not be scored as an unqualified contradiction. (source label: potential_conflict_procedural_qualification / needs_context_not_clean_positive)

pairs.topic: telephone calls while Simpson in Puerto Rico
pairs.note: Both accounts support that Simpson was in Puerto Rico and calls with Faye occurred. The content of the calls is tested separately by CW-001. (source label: compatible_context / no_conflict)

pairs.topic: different time periods for drug use
pairs.note: Simpson's answers concern January-June 1994; Resnick's observations concern October and December 1993. Do not infer a conflict across non-overlapping periods. (source label: non_overlapping_time_scope / no_conflict)
